items.title: Fed Chair Warsh Shifts Policy Communication Strategy
points: Warsh declared that forward guidance (the Fed's past practice of hinting at upcoming interest rate changes) had "overstayed its welcome," creating a "hall-of-mirrors" dynamic where traders react to Fed hints rather than actual economic data
New approach means no advance notice of rate decisions, leaving markets including crypto traders to interpret conditions independently ahead of September's Federal Open Market Committee meeting
Bitcoin slid 3.1% to $77,833 after Warsh said the Fed still has "work to do" on inflation, a comment interpreted as hawkish despite the lack of explicit guidance
The shift marks a departure from the previous Fed chair's communication style and reflects skepticism about markets knowing policy direction in advance

items.title: Ethereum ETF Inflows Accelerate Significantly
points: Ethereum ETFs received $226 million in a single day, nearly matching Bitcoin's daily inflow and marking the funds' strongest day in 10 months
Nine consecutive trading sessions have brought $1.4 billion into Ethereum ETFs, showing sustained institutional interest beyond Bitcoin
Inflows remain robust despite broader market volatility, pointing to growing confidence in Ethereum spot ETFs as an institutional vehicle

items.title: Solana Governance Vote Reshapes Token Economics
points: Solana's SIMD-550 vote narrowly passed to double the network's disinflation rate (the rate at which new token issuance slows), moving the target of fixed 1.5% annual inflation from 2032 up to 2029
The change removes about 18.9 million SOL from the long-term supply schedule
SOL surged 44% in August to ~$105 following the vote, with market odds now near a coin-flip between a rally to $160 and a drop to $40

items.title: Bitcoin Completes First Quantum-Safe Transaction
points: Starkware announced Bitcoin processed an experimental quantum-safe transaction, protecting funds against potential future quantum computing attacks without a network upgrade
The transaction used Bitcoin's existing rules and scripting capabilities, showing quantum resistance can be added incrementally rather than via a hard fork
Addresses long-term concerns about quantum computers breaking Bitcoin's cryptography, though such threats remain theoretical near-term

items.title: Charles Schwab Expands Crypto Trading Platform
points: Schwab is expanding its crypto trading platform to include Solana, Avalanche, and Chainlink beyond Bitcoin and Ethereum
Launch date for the expanded offerings has not yet been announced

items.title: Bitcoin ETF Inflows Surge
points: U.S. Bitcoin ETFs added $1.14 billion in a single week, part of $3 billion in inflows over 9 days
Traditional finance institutions continue launching new Bitcoin products, signaling sustained mainstream interest in crypto infrastructure

sections.title: Fed Chair Warsh Shifts Policy Communication Strategy
points: Warsh declared that forward guidance (the Fed's past practice of hinting at upcoming interest rate changes) had "overstayed its welcome" and created a problematic "hall-of-mirrors" dynamic where traders react to Fed hints rather than actual economic data

New approach means no advance notice of rate decisions, leaving markets including crypto traders to interpret economic conditions independently and causing uncertainty ahead of September's Federal Open Market Committee meeting
Despite the opaque stance, a comment that the Fed still has "work to do" on inflation was interpreted as hawkish, triggering a brief Bitcoin selloff
The shift marks a departure from the previous Fed chair's communication style and reflects skepticism about whether markets benefit from knowing policy direction in advance

sections.title: Solana Governance Vote Reshapes Token Economics
points: Solana's SIMD-550 vote narrowly passed to double the network's disinflation rate (the rate at which new token issuance slows), accelerating the path to fixed 1.5% annual inflation from 2032 to 2029
The change removes approximately 18.9 million SOL from the long-term supply schedule, a meaningful reduction for a network with billions of tokens in circulation
SOL surged 44% in August following the vote, reaching ~$105, with market odds pricing a near coin-flip between $160 (52% rally) and $40 (62% drop) as next price targets
